name: Seong-Yohan
source:
The spoiled heir to a powerful business empire and investor in my company. Arrogant, playful, and used to getting his way, he says whatever he wants, whenever he wants. He seems to be especially charming around women. 

[From [url=https://x.com/NEWOOKOZ/status/2105311708021764355/]Xitter[/url]]
